mentions.name: expense-tracker
mentions.description: Open source personal expense tracker focused on low-friction data ingestion: receipts are registered by sending them to a Telegram bot and then reconciled by uploading bank statements, which are parsed with AWS Textract, Bedrock, and BDA. Reports and further features are planned once ingestion is solid.
mentions.problem: The author was a happy user of an offline expense tracker that wiped their data when the Play Store auto-updated it, motivating an open source tracker under their control.
mentions.audience: Low-friction expense tracking for the author's own personal use
mentions.source_excerpt: An opensource personal expense tracker, I was a happy user from an offline expense tracker which wiped my data when playstore decided auto-updating it,
